name: alex-act-core
description: The Alex ACT baseline runtime plugin. Installs 42 reusable framework skills and 14 slash-command prompts covering epistemic discipline, repository workspace bootstrap, document converters, security and privacy, tooling awareness, and engineering craft. Core authors 18 instructions (17 always-on, 1 pattern-applied), including the Alex Finch runtime personality contract. Install Manager with Core, then run /alex-act-manager install-constellation to bootstrap the seventeen load-bearing instructions. Public source is Alex_ACT_Core; changes remain evidence-gated before release.
